summary: Prestwick Airport controlled airspace deactivated, reverting to uncontrolled airspace with no air traffic service during controller breaks; pilots should monitor 129.455 megahertz.
text:
PRESTWICK AIRPORT CTA/CTR/ATZ DEACTIVATED. AIRSPACE REVERTS TO
CLASS G. ATS NOT AVBL DUE TO MANDATED CONTROLLER BREAKS. PILOTS 
TRANSITING THE AREA ARE TO MONITOR CH129.455.
